findings.title: Utensils, equipment, and linens: properly stored, dried, and handled.
findings.comment: Observed the single-use utensils in the student self-service station were stored with the food contact surfaces and handles intermixed. The inspector educated about the importance of storing utensils in a manner that prevents students from touching the food contact portions of utensils. The PIC removed the utensils and brought them into the kitchen to correct the storage after lunch. Ensure that single-use articles are stored to prevent contamination.
findings.citation_text: 4-904.11(A) Kitchenware and Tableware. (A) SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and cleaned and SANITIZED UTENSILS shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed so that contamination of FOOD and lip-contact surfaces is prevented.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Inspector observes the floor behind the cooking equipment, especially behind and to the right of the oven, to be soiled with what appears to be rodent droppings. The staff states that they have not seen rodents. Ensure that the individuals responsible for cleaning the floor clean this area thoroughly. Clean and maintain clean.

6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.
